scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Jaeren
scenicChapters.narrative: For 12 km this is Norwegian Scenic Route Jaeren, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Egersund → Flekkefjord
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 52 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

norwegian-scenic-route-jaeren.story: Out of Bryne, one way: 115 km, roughly 1 h 53 in the saddle. On the way it passes Orrestranda, Kvassheim Lighthouse and Egersund. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Romania Transalpina
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 38 km this is Romania Transalpina, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-banita-alba-iulia-apulum-domus-1.story: From Baru it runs 206 km to Baru; allow about 3 h 33 of riding. The stops in between: Grădiștea de Munte - Dealul Șesului, Capâlna, Alba Iulia - Apulum / Domus 1 and back through Capâlna. The highest point is about 1,300 m. The line favours views over speed.
